title: Q-ULTRA-stalled_clocks-2: Clocks that stopped out of bounds: restructure: add an independent trigger to the clock that keeps stopping
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** essential variable `stalled_clocks` out of bounds (reading 2; limits 0 to 0)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --check
**Status:** open

ULTRASTABILITY-1 second-order step: restructure: add an independent trigger to the clock that keeps stopping. A clock that stops halts the loop it drives; the system is viable only while every clock keeps ticking, and a watchdog that goes silent reads as unmeasured.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ultrastability --tick` reads `stalled_clocks` inside its bounds.
